'''Ralen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He attained the rank of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] and commanded the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Solidarity (Venator-class)|''Solidarity'']] during the [[Battle of Tirahnn (Clone Wars)|Battle of Tirahnn]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
